checkpoint: Complete state and RNG at round barriers; no unfinished pending emission may be dropped.
clock: Generic independently admitted 3:3:6 reference, not a physical Cs clock.
diagnostic_shedding: Separate explicit signed-support compatible-cost control; not the pilot nuclear loss law.
exposure: Retrospective known-target setting; target files are not read by this generator.
finite_domains: All six pilots at one round; H1-E1 also two rounds; at most six binary choices.

law.outer_return: one new outer closure after all inner rounds, bound to their extended prefixes
law.pacing: own RD + last-two-contact RCD + max(0,R); feedback-off uses own RD after the first common round
law.preparation: distinct p(3,3), n(3,4), e(1,2) seeds; ordered directed ring; common outer enclosure
law.reference: independent 3:3:6 recurrence with RD-paced traversals, one-cut restart
law.reflection_map: declared application bridge: (max(0,lag),max(0,-lag)) directional reflection counts; max(0,lag) adds reflected support extent; admission does not derive this map
law.response: R = orientation_at_emission * RCD * committed receiver-minus-sender recurrence lag
law.rounds: all inner returns and their emitted cross-returns commit before the next round
law.state: complete ordered inner returns, contacts, pending/current round, and RNG state; no histories merged

law_role: Authenticated application choices reused with successor native admission.
observation: Shared native history before any averaging; terminal window is configuration-specific.
sampling_criterion: Union-bound path-indicator Hoeffding diagnostic, alpha=1/100; no favorable-seed selection.
